$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
paths=[p/'checkpoint.json', p/'provider.json']
before={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in paths}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='soodles39-review-') as tmp:
 checkpoint=Path(tmp)/'checkpoint.json'
 checkpoint.write_bytes(paths[0].read_bytes())
 result=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',str(checkpoint),str(paths[1])],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(result.stdout)
 print(result.stderr)
 print('owner_exit_code=',result.returncode)
 print('checkpoint_semantically_unchanged=',json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())==json.loads(paths[0].read_text()))
 assert result.returncode == 0
 out=json.loads(result.stdout)
 assert out['action']=='readback' and out['phase']=='merge_pending' and out['classification'] is None
 assert out['next']['operation']=='advance' and out['next']['required']==['readback']
 assert 'request' not in out
assert before=={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in paths}
print('supplied_files_unchanged=true')
PY
PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -B -m unittest -v test_landing.LandingTests.test_intent_is_persisted_before_exact_head_request_and_no_unchanged_retry test_landing.LandingTests.test_terminal_has_no_next_or_checkpoint_rewrite_and_reconciling_names_binary test_landing.LandingTests.test_crash_after_merge_and_close_resumes_by_readback_without_duplicate_write
